mapper.update: UPDATE sys_custom_field_quota SET field_used = field_used + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND field_used < field_quota
UPDATE sys_custom_field_quota SET index_used = index_used + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND index_used < index_quota

UPDATE sys_custom_field_quota SET index_used = index_used - 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND index_used > 0
